title: Gen 7 alpha · tree search over the policy net
pending: Policy net: `artifacts.gen7_policy` points at v2 (7,968 deals), the newest release. Its own release notes say no arena bot uses it; confirm it for the alpha, or point at a later release.
Match mix: `pair_weights` holds only the alpha pair. Add the producer's other pairs with the share of boards the alpha should get.

Tree tricks: the stage runs at tricks 3 to 6, because the fork-pair bench put the tree's loss at tricks 7 to 13 (docs/gen7_prototype_2026-11-11.md). For the tree from trick 3 to the end, set `to_trick` to 13.
Confirm the bot's other `gen7` settings below (play weights, tie-break, width, depth, layouts).
notes: A Gen 7 bot is its Gen 6 base bot (same bidder, lead net, scorer, layouts and sample count) with the gen7 engine. docs/gen7_alpha_2026-11-11.md explains every setting.

`tree` is a list of stages; a stage applies from `from_trick` to `to_trick`. Different tricks can have different depth, width, layouts and reply model by adding stages. Remove `tree` to run the alpha without the tree.
Audit and capture settings (tie audits, gap forks, room seeds) are carried over from the source run, not set here.
Self-play pairs such as 6-32~6-32 need a runtime with the self-play regime (the collectors' branches have it; `main` at b0909bb validates common and native only).
